definitions.explanation: An official day off designated by the government.
A day on which a festival or celebration is held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祭日|さいじつ}な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Tomorrow is a national holiday, so the company is closed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧{祭日|さいじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}していません→営業する：01878_eigyou⟧。
examples.english: We are closed on Sundays and holidays.
Some households display flags on national holidays.
There is a festival on the village's festival day.

examples.japanese: {祭日|さいじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}って→祝う：01881_iwau⟧⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つけられた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Decorations were put up all over town to celebrate the festival day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭日|さいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}される→披露する：09683_hirou⟧。
examples.english: In this area, traditional dances are performed every year on the autumn festival day.

notes:
{祭日|さいじつ} refers to national holidays or festival days.

TERMS FOR HOLIDAYS:
- {祭日|さいじつ}: holiday (older term)
- ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧: national holiday (official term)
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧: day off, holiday
- ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧: weekday

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧{祭日|さいじつ}: Sundays and holidays
- ⟦{土日|どにち}→土日：12082_donichi⟧⟦{祝|しゅく}→祝：noentry⟧: weekends and holidays
- ⟦{祝|しゅく}→祝：noentry⟧{祭日|さいじつ}: public holidays

JAPANESE NATIONAL HOLIDAYS:
- ⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧: New Year's Day (Jan 1)
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Coming of Age Day
- ⟦{建国|けんこく}→建国：noentry⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: National Foundation Day
- ⟦{春分|しゅんぶん}→春分：19942_shunbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Vernal Equinox Day
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Showa Day
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧: Constitution Day

NOTE: ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧ is more commonly used in modern Japanese than {祭日|さいじつ}.
